convert_arrow_table_to_pandas: convert a pyarrow Table to a pandas DataFrame with configurable dtype_backend and null handling
build_arrow_dtype_mapping: build a mapping from pyarrow types to pandas nullable dtypes for int, uint, bool, string, and float types
create_arrow_string_types_mapper: create a callable that maps pyarrow string types to pandas StringDtype with nan na_value
run_post_convert_dtypes: run post-conversion dtype adjustments including user-provided dtype application and StringDtype-to-object conversion
test_arrow_table_conversion: test arrow_table_to_pandas with numpy_nullable backend, pyarrow backend, and default numpy backend
